description: Keep Coder Session transcript and session controls usable in compact mobile viewports by reducing summary density, adding a transcript height floor, and compacting the recovery bar below the md breakpoint.

tasks.title: Implement compact-viewport CSS accommodations and spec tests for Coder Session
tasks.description: Add pure CSS `md:` breakpoint accommodations to SessionDetailShell.tsx and SessionUsageSummary.tsx so the Coder Session page is usable at compact viewports. In SessionHeader (SessionDetailShell.tsx), hide nonessential metadata items (model, turn count, last-activity, probe-sent, changed-files, duration, session id) and their separator dots with `hidden md:inline`, keeping session name, status badge, stage chip, and cancel button visible. Add `min-h-[120px] md:min-h-0` to the transcript scroll container. Change the recovery bar inner layout to always `flex-row` and reduce wrapper padding to `py-2 md:py-3`. In SessionUsageSummary.tsx, hide secondary token breakdowns (input, output, cached, thought) with `hidden md:inline` and reduce padding to `py-1 md:py-2`. Add spec tests in packages/web/tests/CoderSessionCompactViewport.spec.tsx asserting the structural contract: nonessential metadata carries `hidden md:inline`, essential elements (name, status, stage) do not carry `hidden`, transcript has `min-h` with `md:min-h-0`, recovery bar uses `flex-row`, all existing data-testid anchors are preserved, and desktop layout classes remain unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Nonessential SessionHeader metadata items (model, turn count, last-activity, probe-sent, changed-files, duration, session id) and their `·` separators carry `hidden md:inline` class in the rendered DOM
Session name (h1), StatusBadge, session-stage-chip, and cancel button do NOT carry `hidden` class — they remain visible at all viewports
Transcript scroll container (data-testid=session-transcript-scroll-container) className contains `min-h-[120px]` and `md:min-h-0`
Recovery bar inner content div uses `flex-row` (not `flex-col`) so ContextHealthBar and Compact/Reset buttons are always horizontal
Recovery bar wrapper (data-testid=session-recovery-bar) className contains `py-2` and `md:py-3`
SessionUsageSummary secondary token breakdowns (input, output, cached, thought) carry `hidden md:inline`; total tokens, context %, and cost remain visible

All existing data-testid anchors preserved: session-header, session-transcript-scroll-container, session-sticky-title, session-recovery-bar, session-followup-composer, session-sibling-sidebar, session-recovery-compact, session-recovery-reset

Existing tests pass: npm run typecheck -w packages/web && npm run test:run -w packages/web (CoderSessionEvidence.spec.tsx, SessionPageHeader.spec.tsx, SessionPage.*.test.tsx, GenericSessionPage.test.tsx all green)
New spec test CoderSessionCompactViewport.spec.tsx passes and verifies the structural contract for compact-viewport classes and desktop-layout preservation
tasks.notes: All accommodations are pure CSS md: breakpoint classes — no JS viewport hook (useIsMobile/useNarrowViewport) is introduced. Elements remain in the DOM (hidden via CSS), so existing getByText assertions in SessionPageHeader.spec.tsx remain green without modification. Per design D1-D6.

tasks.title: Add browser tests for pixel-level compact-viewport verification at 375x667 and 320x568
tasks.description: Add browser tests in packages/web/tests/browser/ that render the Coder Session page in a real Chromium layout engine at 375x667 and 320x568 viewports, verifying pixel-level behavior that jsdom cannot assert: transcript scroll container has non-zero visible height (> 0px) on initial load, transcript is independently scrollable, Compact/Reset recovery controls are reachable (not below the fold or covered by fixed mobile navigation), follow-up composer is not covered by mobile navigation, and fixed mobile navigation does not overlap the transcript content area. These tests run via npm run test:browser and do not enter the default npm test.
acceptanceCriteria: Browser test at 375x667 verifies transcript scroll container has visible height greater than 100px on initial load
Browser test at 320x568 verifies transcript scroll container has visible height greater than 0px (never collapses to zero)

Browser test verifies Compact/Reset recovery controls (data-testid=session-recovery-compact, session-recovery-reset) are within the viewport bounds and not covered by the fixed mobile bottom navigation at both 375x667 and 320x568
Browser test verifies follow-up composer (data-testid=session-followup-composer) is not covered by mobile navigation when a running session is viewed at compact viewports
Browser test verifies fixed mobile bottom navigation does not overlap the transcript scroll container's visible content area at both tested viewports
Browser tests pass via npm run test:browser and do not run in default npm test
tasks.output: New packages/web/tests/browser/ test file(s) for CoderSession compact-viewport pixel verification
tasks.notes: Per design D6, browser tests are a separate track verifying real layout behavior. API responses controlled via MSW or browser-test support fixtures. These tests complement the jsdom spec tests in T-001 which verify the structural contract (class presence).
